caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object placed against a plain, off-white or beige background that has some subtle stains or discolorations. The object itself is a rust-brown, box-like metal container with an angular structure, featuring a cross-hatched open side and a solid, riveted top. The top has four visible rivets and a short, upright strap-like handle in the center near one edge. Extending from one side of the container is a long, rectangular, matching rust-brown handle with a small hole near its end. The container, its angular flaps, and the handle are rendered with realistic shading that emphasizes their metallic texture and weathered appearance. The overall composition is centered with the object occupying the majority of the image, and the background remains empty except for the textured discolorations.
title: Hot Coal Carrier
